# What Veneers Actually Cost in the Bay Area (2026)

Porcelain veneers in the North Bay run **$1,100 to $2,400 per tooth**. Composite veneers run **$400 to $900 per tooth**. A typical smile makeover covers 6 to 10 teeth.

## What drives the range

| Factor | Effect on price |
|---|---|
| Material | Porcelain costs 2-3x composite but lasts 10-15 years vs 5-7 |
| Lab | Local ceramist work costs more than an offshore lab |
| Prep work | Existing decay or old crowns add cost before veneers start |

## What insurance covers

Veneers are classified as cosmetic, so Delta Dental, Cigna, and Aetna generally do not cover them. They do cover an underlying crown or filling when the tooth is structurally compromised.

## Questions to ask before you commit

1. Is this porcelain or composite, and which lab?
2. How many appointments, and is there a temporary phase?
3. What is the warranty if one chips?
